_: The module bundles (nix/roles/<name>.nix) and what each brings, by the services' names in the needs (.#needs, nix/lib/needs.nix). No box is given a bundle by hand: a box is built with every bundle of which it can run a service that does not run everywhere (nix/lib/capability.nix: its signed report, its owner's box.json, the policy), whose secrets its own sops file holds, and whose companions it is built with too (nix/lib/fleet-placement.nix); the control plane decides where each placed service runs. services: what the bundle brings. secrets: what its modules read from the box's own sops file whatever else it has (docs/dev/secrets.md: until each is made on the box or sealed to it). with: the bundles that must be built beside it, because its code reaches them on localhost. one: built on one box alone, the first store by name able to build it (its buckets have one writer, which holds no lease). why: what it is for.

core.why: every box: the disk unlock needs the TPM and a cable its initrd has the driver for

gateway.why: one public front door (dd-dns points *.domain at it)

photos.why: photos.<domain> and the gate; its database is its own (the ledger reads counts, not databases)

vault.why: passwords; its sign-in issuer is the gate at home.<domain>, the gateway's, and sessions are per box; its files in the box's own store

media.why: files.<domain>: Files, Movies & TV and the disk images, through the gate

library.why: transcode: H.264 encode on a GPU (Intel only today), else every core; one box only, as its buckets have one writer and no lease

llm.why: a 22G model held in RAM beside the rest; any GPU, any SIMD (nix/modules/llm/needs.nix)

game.why: every world is a KVM guest of 6-8G; the budget is 20G

forge.why: git.<domain>, and postgres shared with photos and vault

runner.why: VM tests (games nests one) and members' jobs; the nix cache in its home's store (nix/modules/forge/needs.nix)

observe.why: thanos reads the metrics bucket in its home's store; the dumps take ente's and forgejo's databases

adblock.why: it answers the house's DNS: the box has to be in the house, with who lives there

compute.why: members' computers are KVM guests, each its own size: a box takes those that fit (its computers.prom says how big), so a small box still runs small ones
